messages:
sara: Design quick-check: group separators in the rules list reduce cognitive load, but the current divider color is too faint on light theme. Also seeing "Invalid order" in tests — needs to be clearer. Screenshot: mobile + desktop.

leo: +1 on stronger dividers. Proposal: 1px border with 8px gap and light neutral #E6E9EE. For disabled rules, replace strike-through with a subtle pill + dimmed label so priority numbers remain legible.

emily: Copy alternatives for the toast: "Ordering blocked — unmet dependencies" or "Action blocked — view dependencies". Add a secondary action "Show dependencies" that opens a focused popover listing the chain.

marcus: For preview overlay: show a translucent timeline at top with "Before -> After" and highlight moved rule in yellow momentarily. CSS snippet I used: ```css
.preview-highlight { animation: fadeSlide 220ms ease-out; }
@keyframes fadeSlide { from { opacity: 0.0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
```
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

a11y-bot: Reminder: keyboard reordering must announce changes with aria-live polite, e.g., "Moved 'Block external traffic' to position 2 of 6" and focus should remain on the moved item. Disabled state needs non-color indicator (icon or pill). Contrast ratios must be >=4.5:1 for small text.

sara: Good. Let's settle on: validation copy = "Ordering blocked — view dependencies" and toast CTA "Show affected rules". Emphasize pill + left sticky index for priority. Marcus, can you prototype the timeline overlay and reduced-motion fallback?

leo: I'll update Figma: thicker divider, disabled pill icon (slashed circle) + color-safe text #374151 at full opacity. Also mock sticky index rail.

emily: I'll write microcopy for the dependency popover — short reason lines and a link to docs. Also add undo snackbar text: "Undo reorder" for 5s.

marcus: Will deliver prototype by EOD. Including the CSS above and reduced-motion variant.

deploy-bot: UX canary pushed to staging: https://staging.redwood.com/routing/editor/priority-groups-canary

sara: Thanks all. Quick 10m walkthrough tomorrow 11:15am to confirm: divider color, validation copy, pill indicator, and aria-live wording. Bring screenshots. :sparkles:
